title: Creé un sitio web para que mi familia y amigos puedan jugar partidas rápidas juntos, cada uno en su propio teléfono.
author: Chidomil

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Chidomil please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low-effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: Chidomil
comments.body:
I've been working on a little personal project: a web-based collection of mini-games inspired by the games I enjoy playing.
It includes a bit of everything, with different types of games so there's something for everyone. The idea was to have a simple place where my family and friends can jump in, have fun, compete against each other, and maybe get a little too competitive. 
The whole thing is hosted on a Raspberry Pi, so I can just leave it running and let everyone connect through their browser.
I used Claude Opus 5.5 to help build it, and it's been a fun project to experiment with and bring together a bunch of ideas I've had.
It's nothing commercial, just a project I built for fun and to share with the people around me.
